convert_caffe2_to_pytorch: run the script to convert a Caffe2 ResNet pickle model to a PyTorch state dict
remove_jigsaw_names: run remove_jigsaw_names to strip jigsaw puzzle suffixes from Caffe2 model blob keys
rename_basic_resnet_weights: run _rename_basic_resnet_weights to remap Caffe2 layer key names to torchvision-compatible ResNet naming
rename_weights_for_resnet: run _rename_weights_for_resnet to remap and filter Caffe2 weights into a PyTorch OrderedDict
convert_bgr2rgb: run convert_bgr2rgb to flip the BGR color channels of conv1 weights to RGB order
